summary: Provides general-purpose utility functions and helper classes supporting caller inspection, execution timing, object formatting, action polling, result wrapping, and JSON serialization.
responsibilities: Retrieve caller context using frame inspection.
Measure execution duration and completion timestamps.
Poll actions until success or timeout.
Wrap synchronous and asynchronous function outcomes in results.
Serialize values to JSON strings and validate JSON against model types.
relationships: The utility package provides helper mechanisms used across general application tasks such as timing, serialization, polling, result wrapping, and caller inspection.
design_decisions: Provides modular utility functions and helper classes for common cross-cutting tasks such as formatting, timing, serialization, and flow control.
